notes: No article morpheme stands anywhere in זִקְנֵי־אָרֶץ, so both written 'the's are supplied determiners: each word takes the one standing before it under rule 29, and nothing is fronted.
The temporal בְּ before the infinitive construct takes 'When' under rule 52, the infinitive keeps the verb, and its suffix takes the English subject pronoun under rule 18.
